A special <c:ffff00>{{response}}<c>: it intercepts the {{opponent}}'s
<c:ffff00>attack<c> and shields an {{ally_battle_term}} by taking the hit.
A <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> or <c:ffff00>{{plant}}<c> in <c:ffff00>{{guard}} Stance<c> (from an <c:ffff00>action<c>
of the <c:ffff00>Block skill<c>) steps in front of the allied <c:ffff00>{{target}}<c>
and <c:ffff00>defends<c> automatically with the stance's <c:ffff00>acting<c>
<c:ffff00>{{part}}<c>.
Defending raises <c:ffff00>Defense Power<c>, and the higher
the <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c> in <c:ffff00>Block<c>, the more it rises. Some
actions negate or {{reflect}} the attack.
